 Trent Reznor and Atticus Ross Scored ‘The Further Mis-Adventures of Cliff Booth’
 The Once Upon a Time ... in Hollywood spinoff directed by David Fincher hits theaters on Nov. 25 and Netflix in December

 Jaeden Pinder

 Atticus Ross, Trent Reznor at Disney's "Tron: Ares" Los Angeles Premiere at TCL Chinese Theatre on October 06, 2025 in Los Angeles, California. 
 JC Olivera/Variety/Getty Images 
 After rumors stirred last month, it’s official: Trent Reznor and Atticus Ross provided the score to The Further Mis-Adventures of Cliff Booth , directed by David Fincher and written by Quentin Tarantino.
 Reznor and Ross have scored six of Fincher’s movies, including The Social Network , Gone Girl , and Mank , the former receiving the Academy Award for Best Original Score in 2011.
 The duo has also struck up a creative partnership with another director in recent years, scoring the last four movies directed by Luca Guadagnino, including Challengers and After the Hunt .
 The Further Mis-Adventures of Cliff Booth is a quasi-sequel to Quentin Tarantino’s 2019 film Once Upon a Time … in Hollywood and arrives in theaters on Nov. 25 before heading to Netflix on December 23. Tarantino will release a novelization of the Booth-centered film on Dec. 8, following the 2021 work Once Upon a Time in Hollywood: A Novel.

 Brad Pitt reprises his role as the eponymous stuntman-turned-fixer and takes place in 1977, eight years after the events of Tarantino’s movie, which altered the events of the Tate-LaBianca murders committed by the Manson Family. Elizabeth Debicki, Scott Caan, Timothy Olyphant, and Yahya Abdul-Mateen II also appear in the spin-off.
 As Nine Inch Nails, Reznor and Ross have kept busy. The pair released Nine Inch Noize , a collaborative record with Boys Noize, in April. Last September, they released the Tron: Ares soundtrack, which marked the first new Nine Inch Nails record in a half decade.
